known_differences: The native Stitch screen covers only the first roughly 2600 CSS pixels, while the official homepage is 10733 CSS pixels tall.
The native Stitch export labels Deutsche Telekom as T-Mobile and simplifies the official product imagery; the source-backed draft uses captured official logos and media instead.
The live hero is interactive and animated; the source-backed draft uses captured still images and links.
A 390px official mobile reference could not be obtained in the selected browser because the viewport override remained at 1280px; mobile comparison remains pending.
Rendered desktop and mobile comparisons of the published draft against the official page remain pending; the draft has not passed visual acceptance.
